intro: I'm a design leader with over a decade of experience building and running product design teams, most recently as Head of Product Design at a Series C SaaS company. I work at the intersection of craft and organization — I still open Figma, but the job now is mostly about the decisions, structures and hires that let a team do their best work at scale.

My background spans 0→1 product design, design systems, and design operations across payments, healthcare, and field-operations software. I'm most useful to a company that needs someone to build a design practice from a standing start, or to bring order and craft back to one that's outgrown its process.

focusAreas.heading: 0→1 product design
focusAreas.body: Taking a problem from first customer conversations through a shipped, validated v1 — comfortable owning research, IA, interaction and visual design when a team is too early to have specialists.

focusAreas.heading: Design systems & design ops
focusAreas.body: Building the governance, tooling and contribution models that let a system survive company growth, not just the components themselves.

focusAreas.heading: Team building & leadership
focusAreas.body: Hiring, mentoring and structuring design teams — including founding design functions inside organizations that had none.

experience.summary: Leading a team of 4 designers and 1 researcher across payments, checkout and merchant tooling.
First design hire; built the design practice and shipped v1 of the field-operations product.
Sponsored and helped staff the company's first design systems team.
